identification: Royal De Luxe portable typewriter (Royal 'A' De Luxe model, c.1935-39, 'Touch Control' branding, chrome trim, round glass-look keys) in black crackle-finish hard case, with original 'Instant Touch System' finger chart and 'Royal Portable' use-and-care booklet. Typewriter Database: De Luxe 'A' from serial 471,000, Touch Control trademark first used April 1935, nickel-chrome plating.

viewing_check: Armitage estimate 60-80, current bid $20 (+22% premium). Check platen/keys condition, that carriage moves and keys strike, case latches, serial number and any rust under the chrome. Sold prices mostly 2024-2026, steady. US sales are Terapeak-converted and fixed-price; AU sales for this exact model are thin (about $100-230). Typewriter is about 6 kg boxed, so postage is not trivial.
